How to cite

For a page:

Andrea Tosti, “[page title]”, EU Digital Policy, [page address], accessed [date]. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

For the data, name the dataset file and the date or commit you used, because the records change as they are verified:

Andrea Tosti, EU Digital Policy dataset, data/[file].json, version of [date or commit]. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

Each record carries the date it was last verified; quoting it alongside a figure tells your reader how current that figure is.
